signature: SUBROUTINE DLARZ( SIDE, M, N, L, V, INCV, TAU, C, LDC, WORK )

params.name: m
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix C.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix C.

params.name: L
params.reference: The number of entries of the vector V containing the meaningful part of the Householder vectors. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $M \ge L \ge 0$, if `SIDE = 'R'`, $N \ge L \ge 0$.

params.name: v
params.reference: The vector v in the representation of H as returned by DTZRZF. V is not used if `TAU = 0`.

params.name: incv
params.reference: The increment between elements of v. `INCV` \<\> 0.

params.name: tau
params.reference: The value $\tau$ in the representation of H.

params.name: C
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by the matrix $H \, C$ if `SIDE = 'L'`, or $C \, H$ if `SIDE = 'R'`.

params.name: ldc
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array C. $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,M)$.
